name: repair-study-confirm-2026-10-28
pre_registered_readouts: 1 gap: target findings among valid source controls (n of 6), conformance findings among healthy controls (n of 3)
3 proposals: slots used, valid policies, each verbatim
4 candidate: target findings under L and B0 (n of 3), beliefs, expected class
5 validation: per case, findings, false beliefs, expected class under B0 and L
7 cost: measured vs bound, channel per role, Mechanic tokens
purpose: Confirmatory replication of repair-study smoke 3 (REPAIRED) under the design frozen at 6e179d0, changing nothing but the pair count from 3 to 6, declared before the run. Approved by the owner on 2026-10-28 ('okay go ahead'). Not the API pilot, which follows it under its own declaration.
replication_criterion: the replication succeeds if the decision is REPAIRED under the frozen rules with 6 pairs; any other decision is reported as the result, without further amendment
stop_rules: every batch is capped at its trials' bound; admission refuses beyond it (the study then ends INCOMPLETE)
a trial ends at 8 model calls, 18 HTTP attempts or 90 wall seconds
a Mechanic session ends at 8 turns
a 402, credit or billing message in run.log stops the run (manual)
the run is killed if it exceeds 90 minutes wall time
